messages:
Jorge (Eng Manager): Heads up — Priya on my team is being promoted from SWE2 -> SWE3 and will also be relocating to the UK effective 2026-04-01. Quick q: can we retro the salary to the effective date and also issue a one-time spot equity grant with the promo? What's the payroll cutoff for UK to get retro pay in April payroll?
Maya (People Ops): Congrats to Priya! Short answers: 1) Retro pay: yes, if the comp-change form and HRIS job change are submitted before payroll cutoff. 2) Spot equity: yes but timing depends on equity committee schedule + local tax review.
Maya (People Ops): Please file the comp-change form here: <https://hr.redwood.com/comp-change-form> and set effective date to `2026-04-01`. Attach manager justification.
Jorge (Eng Manager): Thanks — what's the payroll cutoff date for UK specifically? Our UK payroll runs mid-month?
Alex (Payroll): UK payroll cutoff = third business day before payroll run. For April run that typically means submit by 2026-04-07 for payment in the 4/15 run; if we miss it we can include in 5/15 as retro. Also need the cost center + currency on the form.
Jorge (Eng Manager): Got it. If we submit on 2026-04-08 is there any quick path to backpay in April?
Alex (Payroll): We can only push an off-cycle if there's an emergency and payroll partner approves; expect 2 weeks processing and fees. Not ideal.
HRIS Bot: New ticket created: HRIS-7890 — job_change entry for Priya (effective 2026-04-01). Please update with comp_change_id when available.
Maya (People Ops): For spot equity, we need: manager rationale + suggested grant size + vesting schedule. Equity committee meets monthly; if you hit the docs deadline (2026-04-05) we can include in April awards. If not, next month. Note: international grants require local tax paperwork for UK (P11D/RTI implications).
Jorge (Eng Manager): Who owns the local tax paperwork? Me or People Ops?
Maya (People Ops): People Ops kicks it off but we'll need manager + employee to complete some consent forms. Payroll/Benefits will coordinate for tax forms.
Anika (People Ops Lead): Looping in: @Alex — can you confirm estimated timeline if comp-change form + HRIS update are done by 2026-04-04? Also confirm whether spot equity needs separate payroll routing for UK.
Alex (Payroll): If form + HRIS by 4/04, payroll timeline: included in 4/15 run for base salary. Spot equity: equity issuance is off-payroll (via E*Trade/Shareworks) but we need a payroll mapping for tax withholding if required — that'll add ~1 week to issuance.
Jorge (Eng Manager): Cool. Action items: 1) I will submit comp-change form today with effective 2026-04-01 + cost center + currency. 2) I'll upload manager rationale and grant details by 2026-04-04. 3) Priya will expect possible paperwork from People Ops.
Maya (People Ops): Perfect. I'll watch HRIS-7890 and tag payroll/tax. If anything looks cross-border weird I'll escalate to legal. Thanks. :thumbsup:
Jorge (Eng Manager): Thanks all :pray:
